name: trade-bot-hyperliquid-perp
description:
Decides a Hyperliquid perpetual from one analysis. A clear idea opens or closes. Rules can move the stop or the size. Dry-run and backtest are paper. Live returns an unsigned order and does not sign.

asset - market name, such as BTC. Not a 0x address.
interval - 1m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 8h, 12h, 1d, 3d, 1w, 1M.
candleCount - at least 2.
analysisType - trend_structure, elliott_waves, key_levels, key_level_fibonacci, divergence, range_volatility, bollinger_bands, donchian_breakout, supertrend, ichimoku, z_score, moving_averages, chart_patterns, momentum, candlestick_patterns.
mode - dry-run (default), backtest, live.
momentum - omit (default) or on.
candlestick - omit (default) or on.
percent - positive number, default 50.
stop-to-entry - optional XX YY. XX is above 0 and at most 100. YY is 0 or more and below XX.
trailing-stop - optional XX YY. Each is above 0, max 100.
add-to-position - optional XX YY. Each is above 0, max 100.
remove-from-position - optional XX YY. Each is above 0, max 100.
